# API Contract, Ledger, Range & Scope Checklist: Reports

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements behind the B13 surface frozen for the C13 client: contract completeness, ledger and money correctness, Report Range and Budget Period rules, cross-wallet scope, security.
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [reports.yaml](../../../docs/openapi/paths/reports.yaml) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Depth: standard; audience: PR reviewer. The owner delegated the review to the agent running the design phases, which evaluated each item and fixed the spec where an item failed (resolution log below), as for specs 011–018.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## API contract completeness (C13)

- [x] CHK001 Is every operation's success body, `meta` shape and error-code set specified, including the shared refusals? [Completeness, Spec §5, reports.yaml]
- [x] CHK002 Is the refusal precedence specified for wallet reports and for cross-wallet reports? [Clarity, Spec §6]
- [x] CHK003 Is every query parameter's grammar, default, combination rule and refusal specified per operation? [Completeness, Spec §5, FR-003, FR-019]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec answer each of C13's "Needs from the backend" (shapes, shared Period definition, `reports.advanced`) explicitly? [Traceability, Spec §5 "Answers C13 needs"]
- [x] CHK005 Is the meaning of `label` defined for every report so a client can localise it without guessing? [Clarity, FR-011, FR-013]
- [x] CHK006 Is the presence/nullability of `planned` members defined for both values of `include_planned` in all three reports? [Consistency, FR-014]
- [x] CHK007 Is `wallet_id` defined for both scopes in one schema per report? [Consistency, Spec §5]

## Ledger and money correctness

- [x] CHK008 Is the source of every figure (wallet legs, category legs, opening balance) stated, and `balance_minor` excluded with a test? [Traceability, FR-010, §4]
- [x] CHK009 Is the balance identity stated as an invariant that holds per wallet and across wallets? [Measurability, FR-010, FR-007]
- [x] CHK010 Is the treatment of transfers defined for income/expense, per-wallet transfers, internal cross-wallet transfers and transfers to non-covered or deleted wallets? [Coverage, FR-007, FR-009, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Is it specified that all figures of one response come from one consistent ledger state, so a concurrent write cannot break the identity? [Gap → fixed, FR-017a]
- [x] CHK012 Is the absence of a share/percentage justified and the client's derivation stated? [Clarity, FR-012, ADR-0003 rule 7]
- [x] CHK013 Are no-cross-currency rules stated for wallet reports (one currency by construction) and cross-wallet reports (excluded wallets)? [Consistency, FR-005, FR-008]
- [x] CHK014 Is the dating of the opening balance (undated, every range) specified? [Clarity, Clarifications, FR-010]
- [x] CHK015 Is the platform-category scope rule (ADR-0014 rule 5) and the never-merge-by-name rule (rule 6) applied? [Consistency, FR-008, FR-011]

## Report Range and Budget Periods

- [x] CHK016 Is the default range defined by reference to spec 015's Budget Period algorithm rather than restated differently? [Consistency, FR-002]
- [x] CHK017 Are bounds and behaviour at the date limits defined, including periods computed past them? [Gap → fixed, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Is period membership by calendar date, and the viewer-dependence of only the default range, stated (ADR-0011 rules 6–8)? [Consistency, FR-003, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK019 Is the trend's bucket count, order, zero-fill and labelling specified, and is it clear that `from`/`to` do not apply to it? [Gap → fixed, FR-013]
- [x] CHK020 Is "today" defined without a profile? [Completeness, FR-002, Edge Cases]

## Cross-wallet scope

- [x] CHK021 Is the covered-wallet set defined by role, archive state, deletion state and time (current memberships for every range)? [Completeness, FR-006, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK022 Is `meta.excluded_wallets` defined including archived wallets, its order and its empty form? [Gap → fixed, FR-008]
- [x] CHK023 Is the empty case (no wallet in the currency) specified? [Edge Case, US4 · 8]
- [x] CHK024 Are planned occurrences of transfer rules between covered wallets treated like internal transfers? [Coverage, Edge Cases]

## Security and non-functional

- [x] CHK025 Is read access tied to the Wallets matrix row (W-01) without restating the matrix, with 404 for non-members and deleted wallets? [Completeness, §6, FR-004]
- [x] CHK026 Is the absence of entitlement gating justified by P-09 rule 5, and C13 told no `FEATURE_NOT_ENTITLED` is reachable? [Traceability, FR-020]
- [x] CHK027 Is it stated that report figures are never logged? [Completeness, FR-021]
- [x] CHK028 Are performance targets quantified with data sizes and measurement conditions? [Measurability, SC-005]
- [x] CHK029 Is "not syncable, not on any feed" stated with a test? [Completeness, FR-018, §4]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.

### Resolution log

| Item | Gap found | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| CHK011 | Separate statements under READ COMMITTED could straddle a commit, so `balance_end` and the in-range sums could disagree | FR-017a, invariant row and plan design note 8: one repeatable-read, read-only snapshot per response (A-26) |
| CHK017 | A Budget Period containing a bounded `date` can start before 1900-01-01; the spec was silent | Edge Cases: served as computed; only request inputs are bounded (A-27) |
| CHK019 | Whether the trend accepts `from`/`to` was implicit | FR-013: not declared on the trend, so ignored |
| CHK022 | Whether archived wallets in another currency are listed as excluded was implicit | FR-008: live wallets, archived included |
